info.title: Sleep Puzzle content and payment discovery
info.description: Public content and payment discovery for audio products and sleep consultations. Checkout operations are authenticated browser forms using Paddle card checkout, with CSRF protection and explicit purchase consent. Payment metadata describes discovery only; checkout does not accept MPP Authorization: Payment credentials or issue HTTP 402 payment challenges.

browserSession.name: _sleep_puzzle_session
browserSession.description: Customer browser session established by sign-in. See /auth.md. Form submissions also require the current authenticity_token.

post.summary: Start Paddle card checkout for audio products in the session cart
post.description: Sign in, add products through the storefront, then submit the current cart form with its CSRF and policy tokens and the customer's explicit digital content consent. A Turbo Stream response opens Paddle checkout in the browser. The order remains pending until Paddle confirms payment by webhook. English storefront: /en/orders.

x-payment-info.description: One-time card payment through Paddle. The cart contents determine the price; Paddle checkout displays the final amount, currency, and taxes before payment. Requires interactive browser checkout.

authenticity_token.description: CSRF token from the current cart form.

policy_token.description: Signed policy snapshot from the current cart form.

digital_content_consent.description: Submit only after the customer explicitly accepts the purchase consent.

200.description: Turbo Stream opens checkout or displays a checkout preparation error; this does not confirm payment.

302.description: Redirect to sign-in or the cart for an HTML form submission or invalid cart or consent.

post.summary: Reserve a consultation and start Paddle card checkout
post.description: Sign in and use the current booking form to select an available date, hour, and published package. Submit the form's CSRF and policy tokens and the customer's explicit early service consent. A successful reservation holds the slot while the browser completes Paddle checkout. Paddle's payment webhook confirms the booking. English storefront: /en/bookings.

x-payment-info.description: One-time card payment through Paddle. The selected consultation package determines the price; Paddle checkout displays the final amount, currency, and taxes before payment. Requires interactive browser checkout.

authenticity_token.description: CSRF token from the current booking form.

booking[package_id].description: Published package selected in the booking form.

booking[date].description: Available date from the booking calendar.

booking[hour].description: Available hour in the site's booking timezone, as shown in the form.

booking[policy_token].description: Signed policy snapshot from the current booking form.

booking[early_service_consent].description: Submit only after the customer explicitly accepts the purchase consent.

200.description: Turbo Stream refreshes availability and opens checkout or displays a preparation error; this does not confirm payment.

302.description: Redirect to sign-in or the booking page for an HTML form submission.

422.description: Invalid CSRF token or booking validation failure, including unavailable slot, unpriceable package, or missing consent.
